refConvention.stepPostState: traces[i].steps[j].postState is complete after that step
refConvention.mutationBase: mutations[].base.afterStep selects that postState as pre-mutation context
refConvention.quantities: amount/unit/asset/scale are strings; scale 0 means integer asset units; milliWETH scale 3 is toy
refConvention.nominalVsToken: kind token-transfer or fee moves balances; nominalChanges do not
refConvention.footprintCounts: per-trace access. Each step that writes a resource increments that resource write count. Distinct from unique-resource cardinality. Bounds are maxima on per-trace accesses.
refConvention.uniqueResourceVsAccess: unique resource count is the number of distinct resource ids. access count is the number of writes across steps of one trace.
refConvention.expectedStateRef: mutations[].expectedStateRef.equals names the complete selected base or alternateAdmittedContext.completeState. Equality is complete-state-identity. financialStateUnchanged:true is not a result.
refConvention.minReceive: 2*receivedMilliWETH >= debitUSDC + inputFeeUSDC. Fees in the input asset count.
refConvention.custodyNegatives: Custody failures admit the entire alternate as a distinct fixed toy starting boundary. genesis/admin/intent/plan/controller/currentHead/work belong to that boundary. No pointer to the original funded preState or history. Treasury is a starting balance.
refConvention.legalStepRef: mutations[].mutatedInput.legalStepRef names a complete legal step. exactOverrides replace listed fields. Inherited duties/allowance/history/work come from that step, not from an earlier prefix.
refConvention.finiteConjunction: The four mandatory claims are the admittedToyContext.mandatoryClaimFiniteConjunction plus the trace updateRelation. Record references do not themselves supply those predicates.
refConvention.quantityUnits: Every amount record uses assetUnitScaleRegistry unit and scale for its asset. Midnight.USDC and Assumed.ForeignUSDC are asset ids. Their unit is USDC scale 0.
